ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels covering approximately 85-90% of the visible ventral area, contrasted against low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels on the trailing edge and central notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive high-intensity white field across both lobes; low-intensity dark pigmentation forms a continuous band along the entire trailing edge and a localized vertical dark patch at the median notch. Minor dark spotting is scattered across the interior of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees and a depth relative to the vertical lobe height of roughly 1:6.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations characterize the central trailing edge, transitioning to higher-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and valleys at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, sweeping upward towards pointed and slightly hooked distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense dark-pixel clusters consistent with colonization scarring located at the extreme left and right tips, and a large concentrated dark cluster at the median notch vertex.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, dark diagonal linear mark is visible on the inner-mid region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy pigmentation/scarring at the distal tips and notch; sporadic small dark spots on the ventral surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Dot-matrix style alphanumeric metadata overlay at the bottom margin: 'JAC97-9/24 ID 13551 JOHN CALAMBOKIDIS S# N2-1 19 July 97 WA/BC'.
